info.title: pqfe — PostQuantum.FileEncryption CLI
info.description: Command-line file encryption built on PostQuantum.FileEncryption: `pqfe encrypt` / `pqfe decrypt` for the FROZEN .pqfe v2 container format. Authenticated AES-256-GCM with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 or Argon2id passphrase derivation, atomic output files, fail-closed decryption (wrong passphrase and tampered ciphertext are indistinguishable errors), and sysexits.h exit codes for scripting. Passphrases come from a no-echo prompt or an environment variable for CI use. Install: dotnet tool install -g PostQuantum.FileEncryption.Tool. Requires the .NET 10 runtime or later.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: pqfe — encrypt and decrypt .pqfe containers from the command line.

options.name: --argon2id
options.description:
Use Argon2id (memory-hard) instead of PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256.
Decryption reads the KDF from the container header — no flag needed.

options.name: --passphrase-env
options.description:
Read the passphrase from environment variable VAR
instead of prompting. Recommended for scripts and CI.
Caveat: environment variables are visible to child
processes and can surface in crash dumps and process
inspection — scope VAR to the single invocation.
Exit codes follow sysexits.h conventions: 0 ok, 64 usage,
65 data error (wrong key or tamper), 66 missing input, 74 i/o.
